limits: Scripted pilots are not measured human beginners or PvP win-rate predictions.
Input/aim decision and threat-avoidance policies are illustrative; the pressure controller does not fight skillfully or use offensive secondary weapons.
No live accounts, purchases, credits or production config writes. Bank route models validated extraction amounts; bank/ownership transaction correctness has separate real SQLite/Room gates.
Account route assumes successful unlocking/equipping when sufficient credits exist; excludes tutorial, sign-in, human menu/reading time and network delay.
250 is all20 fighter upgrades; cruiser evolution is additional. Permanent1500 credit unlock differs from in-match50 mineral purchase.
Old fully loaded power ceiling includes500 hull from carried wealth; old1240 shop price alone did not purchase that500 hull. Power ratios are not a linear cost rule.

power.scope: primary+automatic throughput × hull+shield; excludes aiming, regen, missiles/mines and cruiser roles
power.warning: Includes removal of wallet-based health; old fully loaded state requires additional retained wealth. Tactical ordnance/accuracy/regen/capital roles excluded.
